email_draft.subject: Magnolia Heights' RFP-26-MH-007 scoped in time, by Journify
email_draft.body:
Your team posted RFP-26-MH-007 for Special Education Case Management Software on April 15, and proposals close June 1.

At 378 students on IEPs, your case managers are likely carrying documentation loads that leave little room for actual instruction. Journify goes beyond case management: it handles IEP drafting, progress monitoring, parent communication, and personalized instructional materials, with ESSA Tier 4 research certification through Digital Promise, and integrates with whichever IEP system your district adopts. Your whole SPED team, teachers, paraprofessionals, and related-service providers, works from one connected workflow instead of chasing paperwork in separate places. We can have a scoped proposal response in front of your committee well before June 1.

Should I get on your calendar this week to scope a response to RFP-26-MH-007?
